help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Have a question? We're here to help

faq.a1: Vertex Command is a SaaS platform for managing prop trading accounts. It lets you track all accounts in one place, manage firm rules, drawdown tracking, withdrawals, and more.
faq.q2: How do I add a new account?
faq.a2: Click 'New Account' on the dashboard, fill in the details (name, firm, account size, balance) and click 'Add Account'.
faq.a3: Free is limited to 3 accounts. Pro ($29/mo) allows 20 accounts + integrations. Trader ($79/mo) includes 100 accounts + auto sync. Desk ($199/mo) is unlimited + team support.
faq.q4: How does the priority engine work?
faq.a4: The engine analyzes each account by performance, proximity to target, risk level and consistency. It gives a score of 0-100 and a recommendation (trade / light trading / avoid / do not trade).
faq.a5: Go to the integrations page, select Tradovate, enter your username and password. The system will find all accounts and let you import them.
faq.a7: FTMO requires a 10% profit target, maximum 5% daily drawdown, and maximum 10% total drawdown. You must trade at least 4 days during the evaluation period.
faq.a10: You can withdraw profits after your account reaches Funded status and meets the firm's minimum trading days. There's usually a 14-30 day waiting period.

a1.title: Creating an Account & First Login
a1.content:
1. Sign up with email and password
2. Choose a plan (Free / Basic / Pro / Unlimited)
3. You'll arrive at the main dashboard
4. Add your first account via the 'New Account' button

The free plan includes up to 3 accounts. Upgrade anytime from the billing page.

a2.title: Dashboard Overview
a2.content:
The dashboard shows:
• KPI Summary — total balance, P&L, active accounts
• Performance chart over time
• Trading calendar — green (profit) and red (loss) days
• Account table with status, drawdown, and priority score

a3.title: Language & Interface Settings
a3.content:
The system supports 4 languages: Hebrew, English, Arabic, Spanish.
Click the language button in the top corner to switch.
The interface automatically adjusts to RTL for Hebrew and Arabic.

a1.title: Adding a New Account
a1.content:
1. Click 'New Account' on the dashboard
2. Fill in: account name, prop firm, fund size, current balance
3. Set drawdown rules (daily, maximum, type)
4. Click 'Add'

Alternatively — connect a broker via the Integrations page and import accounts automatically.

a2.title: Priority Engine — What to Trade Today
a2.content:
The engine calculates a 0-100 score for each account based on:
• Proximity to profit target
• Distance from drawdown
• Consistency (not too much profit in one day)
• Remaining trading days

Recommendations: Trade / Light Trading / Avoid / Do Not Trade.

a3.title: Trading Calendar
a3.content:
The calendar shows a color for each trading day:
• Green = profitable day
• Red = losing day
• Gray = no trades

Click on a day to see trade details.

a1.title: Connecting TopstepX
a1.content:
1. Go to the Integrations page
2. Click 'New Connection' and select TopstepX
3. Enter your TopstepX username and password
4. The system will find all accounts
5. Choose which accounts to import

Data syncs automatically every few minutes.

a2.title: Connecting Tradovate
a2.content:
Tradovate is in development (Coming Soon).
You can currently import data from Tradovate via CSV file in the trading journal.

We'll update when direct API connection is available.

a3.title: Syncing Trades
a3.content:
After connecting a broker:
• Auto sync — the system pulls new trades automatically
• Manual sync — click the 'Sync' button on the journal page
• Per-account sync — click the sync button next to each account

a1.title: Creating a Copy Group
a1.content:
1. Go to the Copy Trading page
2. Click 'New Group'
3. Select a leader account
4. Add follower accounts
5. Set quantity ratio (1:1, 2:1, etc.)
6. Activate the group

Trades opened on the leader account will be copied automatically.

a2.title: Slippage Settings
a2.content:
You can set a maximum slippage limit:
• By percentage — e.g., 0.5%
• By ticks — e.g., 2 ticks

If price moves beyond the limit — the trade won't be copied.
Recommended to set this to avoid entering at bad prices.

a3.title: Engine Monitoring & Status
a3.content:
The copy trading dashboard shows:
• Engine status (Active / Paused / Idle)
• Copied trades in real-time
• Copy history
• Errors (if any)

Pause the group anytime if you need to stop copying.

a1.title: Auto vs Manual Mode
a1.content:
The trading journal works in 2 modes:

• Auto — trades sync from broker connections. You can sync by connection, firm, or account.
• Manual — add trades manually or import from CSV file.

Switch between modes with the Toggle button at the top of the page.

a2.title: Auto Tags
a2.content:
The system auto-tags trades:
• Scalp — trade shorter than 5 minutes
• Swing — trade longer than 60 minutes
• Breakout — profit over $500
• Reversal — profit despite price moving against entry direction

Auto tags appear in orange with a robot icon.

a3.title: Smart Alerts
a3.content:
The system detects patterns and alerts:
• Losing streak — 3+ consecutive losses
• Daily loss exceeded — beyond your set limit
• New P&L record — positive notification
• Win rate drop — below threshold

Configure alerts via the settings button on the Alerts tab.

a4.title: Session Analysis
a4.content:
The system classifies trades into 3 sessions:
• Asia — 18:00-02:00 EST
• Europe — 02:00-08:00 EST
• US — 08:00-16:00 EST

See Win Rate, average P&L, and weekly heat map for each session.

a1.title: Plan Comparison
a1.content:
• Free — up to 3 accounts, basic dashboard
• Basic ($29/mo) — 20 accounts, integrations, journal
• Pro ($79/mo) — 100 accounts, copy trading, AI
• Unlimited ($199/mo) — unlimited, priority support

a2.title: Changing Plans
a2.content:
1. Go to the Billing page
2. Select a new plan
3. Complete payment via Stripe

Upgrade — immediate. Downgrade — at end of current billing period.
Cancellation — plan stays active until end of paid period.

a3.title: Payment Methods
a3.content:
Payment is processed via Stripe and supports:
• Credit/debit card
• Google Pay / Apple Pay

All data is encrypted and secure. We don't store card details.

a1.title: Drawdown Types
a1.content:
• Static — loss measured from the account's initial size
• Trailing — loss measured from the highest peak the account reached

Example: $50K account with 10% static drawdown = loss line at $45K.
With trailing drawdown, if you reached $55K, the loss line rises to $49.5K.

a2.title: Consistency Rules
a2.content:
Some firms require consistency — no more than 30-40% of total profit in a single day.

The system calculates a consistency score automatically and warns if a too-successful trading day might hurt the score.

a3.title: Advanced Risk Analytics
a3.content:
The risk analytics page shows:
• P&L distribution
• Maximum actual drawdown
• Risk per trade
• Sharpe Ratio
• Risk/reward ratio

a1.title: Interface Not Loading / White Screen
a1.content:
1. Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Delete)
2. Hard refresh the page (Ctrl+F5)
3. Try a different browser
4. Check your internet connection

If the issue persists — check system status in the 'System Status' tab.

a2.title: Trades Not Syncing
a2.content:
1. Verify the broker connection is active (Integrations page)
2. Try manual sync (sync button in journal)
3. Check the account isn't suspended
4. Disconnect and reconnect if needed

Sync may take up to a minute after closing a trade.

a3.title: Copy Trading Not Copying
a3.content:
1. Verify the group is in 'Active' status
2. Check the engine is running (green status)
3. Verify slippage limit isn't blocking (try increasing)
4. Check the follower account isn't suspended
5. Pause and restart the group

a4.title: Payment / Billing Issues
a4.content:
1. Verify your credit card is valid and not blocked
2. Try a different card
3. Check for payment blocks from your bank

For double charges or refunds — contact support via the bot.

problem.title: Problem & Solution
problem.subtitle: Prop traders face critical operational challenges that cost them money every day
pains: Managing 10-50+ funded accounts across different firms manually
Tracking drawdown rules, consistency requirements, and profit targets in spreadsheets
Missing withdrawal windows because of disorganized data
No unified view of total P&L, risk exposure, or account health
Hours wasted daily on admin tasks instead of trading
solutions: One dashboard to manage all accounts across all firms
Automated rule engine that tracks every firm's requirements
Smart priority scoring — know exactly which accounts to trade today
Real-time risk monitoring with intelligent alerts
API integrations for automatic account sync
